text: The Patriots face Jacksonville in Week 3 with a notably depleted edge rush, having ruled out both OLB Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) and OLB Quintayvious Hutchins (knee), with the latter also placed on injured reserve, while CB Carlton Davis III is expected to return from injury. On a more encouraging note, rookie TE Eli Raridon has returned to practice and appears to be progressing toward availability against the Jaguars, who arrive in Foxborough looking to capitalize on what they perceive as a Patriots team still "finding ourselves" after a pair of second-quarter clock management lapses that New England has acknowledged as something that desperately needs cleaning up before Sunday. Beyond the field, the organization also made time this week to celebrate Hispanic Heritage Month alongside Christian Gonzalez, Andy Borregales, and other teammates at an event hosted by the Patriots Foundation, IBA, and Bank of America at La Casa in Boston.
